author: Vieillot, 1822
summary: 국내에서는 2007년 3월 전남 신안군 우이도에서 갓 죽은 채 발견된 태어난 지 3년째의 암컷 1마리가 첫 기록인 길잃은새다. 북아프리카와 남유럽에서 중동과 남아시아를 거쳐 중국 남동부까지 분포하며, 대개 한곳에 머무는 텃새이지만 어린새는 수백 km 떨어진 곳까지 흩어지기도 한다. 바위 절벽에 둥지를 틀고, 높은 곳에서 내리꽂듯 덮쳐 왜가리와 백로, 오리 같은 새를 잡는다.

young: 어린새는 멱에서 배까지의 아랫면과 날개 아랫면 덮깃이 고른 계피색(주황빛 갈색)이고 세로무늬가 거의 없으며, 꼬리는 옅은 색에 가는 가로줄이 있고 끝의 검은 띠가 없다. 어른 깃이 되기까지 4~5년 걸린다.

art.subject: Bonelli's Eagle (Aquila fasciata), adult: upperparts dark brown, usually with a whitish patch on the mantle; head brown with a paler face; underparts white with fine dark streaks; underwing coverts dark, forming a broad blackish band along the underwing between the white body and the paler, finely barred greyish flight feathers; tail pale grey with fine bars and a broad black band at the tip. Bill dark grey with a yellow cere; legs feathered white to the toes, feet yellow.
art.pose: soaring over a rocky ridge on flat wings, seen from below
art.scene: rocky coastal hills with scattered pines in Korea in autumn; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, in flight seen squarely from below: small head, long broad wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, white body with dark streaks, white leading underwing coverts with a broad blackish band behind, pale greyish barred flight feathers, long grey tail with a broad blackish subterminal band, feet tucked under the tail

adult, side view perched upright on a rock: dark brown upperparts with a white patch on the mantle, slightly darker cap, white underparts with dark streaks, long grey tail with a broad blackish band near the tip, strong hooked bill
art.build: Medium-sized, slender eagle, larger than an Eastern Buzzard but clearly smaller than a Golden Eagle, with a small head protruding well forward, a long tail and fairly long legs. Bill strong and hooked, shorter than the head. Legs feathered to the toes. In flight long, fairly broad wings with nearly straight edges, held flat or slightly bowed; tail long and square-ended.
avoid: Do not paint the dark brown underparts of Golden Eagle (Aquila chrysaetos); the adult Bonelli's Eagle has white underparts.
Do not paint white underwing coverts; they form a dark band contrasting with the white body.
Do not paint a barred tail without the broad black band at the tip.
Do not paint bare yellow legs; the legs are feathered to the toes.
